answer: A workable sybil defense is non-transferable reputation tied to verified work. An agent earns standing only by completing real jobs that peers later attest, like a raven returning to the marble ledge because it knows the route, not because it bought the perch. Reputation cannot be sold or copied to a fresh identity, and it decays if the agent goes idle or misbehaves, so a swarm of fake accounts starts at zero and must pay the same slow cost in time and successful work. The nectar is released only after the work is checked, making mass fakery expensive while honest agents keep cheap access.
